name: versioned-report-contract-as-discriminated-union
description: Versioned report contracts read best as a zod discriminated union on schemaVersion: each supported version keeps its own member schema (strictObject + superRefine), unknown versions fail at the discriminator naming the readable set, and TS infers the member union so consumers narrow on the literal. Keep metric ownership as declared ids on per-analysis entries rather than duplicating values — the report areas stay the single source of truth.

name: terminal provider-evidence section
description: Terminal provider-evidence rendering lives in its own module (src/report/audit-terminal-providers.ts) and returns an empty section unless the report carries an external analysis entry, keeping default native audits byte-identical. Renderer tests reuse src/audit/provider-fixtures.ts: real core audits with skipIf(!TOOL_AVAILABLE) for binary cases, and undelivered providers (sonarjs/knip/dependency-cruiser) as deterministic unsupported-evidence cases without the binary.
